name: docsy-starter

scripts._commit:public: HASH=$(git rev-parse --short main); cd public && git add -A && git commit --allow-empty -m "Site at $HASH"
scripts._filename-error: echo 'ERROR: the following files violate naming conventions; fix using: `npm run fix:filenames`'; echo; npm run -s _ls-bad-filenames; exit 1
scripts._netlify:prepare: npm run -s is:clean && npm run install:safe && npm run -s is:clean
scripts.approve:hugo: npm approve-scripts --allow-scripts-pin hugo-extended && npm run test:repo && npm run _rebuild:hugo
scripts.check:format: npm list prettier && npm run _check:format || (echo '[help] Run: npm run fix:format'; exit 1)
scripts.diff:check: npm run _diff:check || (echo; echo 'WARNING: the files above have not been committed'; echo)
scripts.refcache: echo 'WARNING: refcache is deprecated. Use link-cache moving forward.' >&2 && npm run link-cache --
scripts.seq: bash -c 'for cmd in "$@"; do npm run $cmd || exit 1; done' -
scripts.test: npm run -s _list:theme && npm run check:format && npm run test:repo && npm run check:links
scripts.update:docsy: echo 'INFO: set VERSION to desired Docsy version' && npm install -D @docsy/theme@${VERSION:-latest} && npm list @docsy/theme
scripts.update:hugo: VERSION=${VERSION:-$(npm run -s _docsy-hugo-version)} npm run _install:hugo && echo 'INFO: review the hugo-extended release, then run: npm run approve:hugo'

enginesComment: Ensure that engines.node value stays consistent with the project's .nvmrc; the npm floor is where allowScripts support landed (silently ignored on older npm)
